# telnyx_rcs_agent_test_devices (Data Source)

Lists rcs agent test devices, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_rcs_agent_test_device`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `rcs_agent_test_devices` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rcs_agent_test_devices))
